prompt: For this return carton, either end of the insert can take the shipping strap, but the courier must read the barcode without lifting the strap. The insert’s lined face belongs against the glass; write the return number on the rough face, not on the temporary strap. The right strap channel would cross the barcode, so the packer should _____.
promptZh: 這個退貨紙箱的內襯兩端都可穿束帶，但快遞必須不用掀起束帶就能讀取條碼。內襯加墊的一面要貼玻璃，退貨編號須寫在粗糙面，不可寫在臨時束帶上。右側穿束帶處會橫過條碼，因此包裝人員應_____。

options.text: turn the rough face toward the glass, pass the strap through the left channel, and write on the rough face
options.zh: 讓粗糙面貼玻璃，束帶走左側，編號寫粗糙面
options.whyZh: 束帶與書寫位置正確，但貼玻璃的應是加墊面。

options.text: turn the lined face toward the glass, pass the strap through the left channel, and write on the rough face
options.zh: 讓加墊的一面貼玻璃，束帶走左側，編號寫粗糙面
options.whyZh: 加墊面貼玻璃，左束帶保持右邊條碼可讀，並把退貨編號寫在粗糙面。

options.text: turn the lined face toward the glass, pass the strap through the right channel, and write on the rough face
options.zh: 讓加墊的一面貼玻璃，束帶走右側，編號寫粗糙面
options.whyZh: 接觸面和書寫位置正確，但右束帶會遮住條碼。

options.text: turn the lined face toward the glass, pass the strap through the left channel, and write on the strap
options.zh: 讓加墊的一面貼玻璃，束帶走左側，編號寫束帶
options.whyZh: 接觸面與左側束帶都正確；退貨編號應寫在粗糙面，而非臨時束帶。

explanationZh: 加墊面貼玻璃，左束帶保持右邊條碼可讀，並把退貨編號寫在粗糙面。
evidence: without lifting the strap / lined face belongs against the glass / The right strap channel would cross the barcode / write the return number on the rough face, not on the temporary strap.

vocabulary.note: face 可指零件的其中一個表面；lined 表示覆有內襯或保護層。
